credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Portrait of Georgia O'Keeffe at Ghost Ranch holding a steer skull on her lap on the steps of her courtyard patio.  Exterior/ outdoor view with 2 intersecting  portales behind her and a view of the mountain above the roof line. She sits on the stone steps facing the camera wearing leather loafers, a black suit jacket over a white button-up collared shirt, and a white flowing head scarf under her signature black wide rim hat (with a telescope crease/bash). Shrubbery and a kiva ladder to the roof and on the viewer right.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe, Ghost Ranch
